title: Mouse emulation limitation on mobile
body:
### Tested versions

4.4

### System information

iPadOS 26

### Issue description

I want to use apps like Material Maker on iOS. This app is designed for desktop, but that's not the issue. I found that `emulate_mouse_from_touch` is being hindered. I'm happy to do a bit of porting, but after manually sending mouse events the app does not behave as intended. So even if you had a mouse it would not behave correctly. This is problematic for porting and supporting mouse input on iOS in the future.

Ideally for me, the mouse would be controlled by a virtual trackpad. I've already tried to implement one and it doesn't work out because of this issue. My expectation is that the app will behave identically to desktop if `emulate_mouse_from_touch` is enabled. Enabling mouse emulation should be enough to use the app via touchscreen, but it's not.

The Tree node was the first one to give me trouble. I'm pretty sure the problem is somewhere around here
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/master/scene/gui/tree.cpp#L4184C6-L4184C81

The is_touchscreen_available() check is suspicious. While it's probably there to facilitate scroll, it makes it impossible to drag or select items out of the Tree. This could be reproduced on desktop if you make is_touchscreen_available() return true.

 You can see in my MM fork how I tried to work around it:
https://github.com/celyk/material-maker/commit/bce8f097f97c277272f592b3d304a541946b0074

Maybe the scroll can be made optional, because I don't like how it's interfering with my mouse events. I'm trying to bring a desktop experience to iPad. Converting it into a touchscreen experience would be a massive undertaking compared to `emulate_mouse_from_touch` just doing as it should.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a Tree node
2. Add items to the tree
3. Export for iOS
4. Try to select or drag the elements
### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

You could maybe look at my fork, but MM is not hard to get running on iOS
https://github.com/RodZill4/material-maker
